*Note.* 773,424 sentences in 86,956 mixed profiles for the logit; worker fixed effects and worker-clustered standard errors. Function reference: dictionary-coded identity, credential, or capability (the estimation label is ‘individuating claim’); relative position runs from 0 (first qualifying sentence) to 1 (last). Intervals are normal-approximation Wald intervals. The specificity OR is per one-unit increase in log(1 + distinct informative types), not per additional word. The linear-probability column is a link-function check on direction; it uses all 2,309,694 eligible sentences, including profiles whose sharing outcome does not vary, and no odds-ratio transformation applies.
